# Good Scope Timing Examples
# Demonstrates proper scope usage following "The Golden Rule"

namespace = scope_timing_good

# THE GOLDEN RULE: Event Evaluation Order
# 1. trigger = { }    <- Evaluated FIRST
# 2. desc = { }       <- Evaluated SECOND
# 3. immediate = { }  <- Runs THIRD (scopes created here)
# 4. Portraits        <- Displayed FOURTH
# 5. Options          <- Rendered FIFTH
#
# RULE: Scopes created in 'immediate' are NOT available in 'trigger' or 'desc'

# Example 1: Correct - Save scope in trigger (before use in desc)
scope_timing_good.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0001.t
	desc = scope_timing_good.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# CORRECT: Save scope in trigger
		any_vassal = {
			is_adult = yes
			save_temporary_scope_as = potential_ally
		}
	}

	# Now scope:potential_ally is available in desc
	# (because trigger runs before desc)

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0001.a
		# scope:potential_ally is still available here
		scope:potential_ally = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = grateful_opinion
			}
		}
	}
}

# Example 2: Correct - Don't reference immediate scopes in trigger
scope_timing_good.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0002.t
	desc = scope_timing_good.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# CORRECT: No reference to scopes created in immediate
		gold >= 100
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
		liege = {
			save_scope_as = my_liege
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0002.a
		# CORRECT: Use scopes created in immediate only in options
		scope:my_liege = {
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}
}

# Example 3: Correct - Save scopes early for desc/title
scope_timing_good.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0003.t
	# CORRECT: desc uses scope saved in trigger
	desc = {
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				scope:rival = {
					is_alive = yes
				}
			}
			desc = scope_timing_good.0003.desc_alive
		}
		desc = scope_timing_good.0003.desc_default
	}

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# CORRECT: Save scope in trigger so desc can use it
		any_courtier = {
			has_relation_rival = root
			save_temporary_scope_as = rival
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0003.a
		scope:rival = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}
}

# Example 4: Correct - Pass scopes to triggered events
scope_timing_good.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0004.t
	desc = scope_timing_good.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
		random_vassal = {
			save_scope_as = chosen_vassal
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0004.a
		# CORRECT: Pass scopes to the triggered event
		trigger_event = {
			id = scope_timing_good.0005
			days = 30
		}
		# scope:chosen_vassal will be available in the triggered event
		# because it's triggered from this option (immediate context)
	}
}

scope_timing_good.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0005.t
	desc = scope_timing_good.0005.desc

	# This event can safely use scope:chosen_vassal
	# because it was triggered from .0004's option

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0005.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 5: Correct - Check variable existence properly
scope_timing_good.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0006.t
	desc = scope_timing_good.0006.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# CORRECT: Set variable in trigger before checking
		NOT = { has_variable = already_fired }
	}

	immediate = {
		# Now set the variable
		set_variable = {
			name = already_fired
			value = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0006.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 7: Correct - Static scopes in localization
scope_timing_good.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0007.t
	# CORRECT: Localization uses static scopes (root, liege, etc.)
	desc = scope_timing_good.0007.desc # Can reference [ROOT.GetName], [ROOT.GetTitledFirstName], etc.

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
		# Scopes saved here NOT available in desc localization
	}

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0007.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 8: Correct - Use trigger for scope filtering
scope_timing_good.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0008.t
	desc = scope_timing_good.0008.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# CORRECT: Find and save the scope in trigger
		any_vassal = {
			is_adult = yes
			has_trait = ambitious
			save_temporary_scope_as = ambitious_vassal
		}
	}

	# Now ambitious_vassal is available everywhere

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0008.a
		scope:ambitious_vassal = {
			add_prestige = 100
		}
	}
}

# Example 9: Correct - Portraits use static scopes
scope_timing_good.0009 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0009.t
	desc = scope_timing_good.0009.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# Save scope for portraits
		any_spouse = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = my_spouse
		}
	}

	# CORRECT: Portraits can use scopes saved in trigger
	left_portrait = root
	right_portrait = scope:my_spouse

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0009.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 10: Correct - Multiple scope saves in trigger
scope_timing_good.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scope_timing_good.0010.t
	desc = {
		# CORRECT: Both scopes saved in trigger
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				scope:ally = { is_alive = yes }
			}
			desc = scope_timing_good.0010.desc_ally
		}
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				scope:rival = { is_alive = yes }
			}
			desc = scope_timing_good.0010.desc_rival
		}
		desc = scope_timing_good.0010.desc_default
	}

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# Save multiple scopes in trigger
		any_vassal = {
			has_relation_friend = root
			save_temporary_scope_as = ally
		}
		any_courtier = {
			has_relation_rival = root
			save_temporary_scope_as = rival
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = scope_timing_good.0010.a
		scope:ally = {
			add_gold = 50
		}
		scope:rival = {
			add_prestige = 25
		}
	}
}
